en.description:
Bring your pet along for daily movement and adventure. WatchPet is a virtual pet game for iPhone and Apple Watch.
Features:
• Hatch a companion: Receive a pet egg, choose a name, and watch your new friend hatch.
• Care every day: Feed, train, clean, and treat your pet as it grows.
• Discover new forms: Follow your pet through multiple evolutionary forms all the way to Mega.
• Battle with skills: Take on encounters and enjoy animated attacks and powerful skills.
• Turn movement into adventure: Optionally read steps and activity from Apple Health to trigger encounters and earn in-game activity rewards.
• Stay together across devices: Care for the same pet on iPhone and a paired Apple Watch.
• Shop and keep a journal: Find items, manage supplies, and revisit your pet’s growth and adventures.

zh.trackName: Watch Petmon-你的电子宠物 手表游戏
zh.description:
让宠物陪你运动，让每天都有新的冒险。WatchPet 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的电子宠物游戏。
主要功能：
• 孵化宠物：领取宠物蛋，为伙伴取名，等待它破壳而出。
• 日常照护：喂养、训练、清洁和治疗宠物，关注它的状态与成长。
• 多种进化形态：陪伴宠物逐步成长，见证它进化至究极体。
• 战斗与技能：参加遭遇战，体验不同形态的攻击动作和强力技能。
• 运动与冒险：授权读取 Apple 健康中的步数和活动数据，让步数触发遭遇战，并获得游戏内运动奖励。
• 双设备陪伴：在 iPhone 和配对的 Apple Watch 上照顾同一只宠物。
• 商城与日志：选购道具、管理物品，回顾宠物的成长和冒险记录。

ja.description:
ペットと一緒に体を動かし、毎日を冒険に変えましょう。WatchPet は iPhone と Apple Watch で楽しめるバーチャルペットゲームです。
主な機能：
• ペットを孵化：卵を受け取り、名前を付けて、新しい相棒の誕生を待ちます。
• 毎日のお世話：エサやり、トレーニング、掃除、治療をしながら成長を見守ります。
• 多彩な進化形態：段階ごとの変化を楽しみ、究極体まで育てます。
• バトルとスキル：遭遇バトルに挑み、攻撃アニメーションや強力なスキルを楽しめます。
• 運動が冒険に：Apple ヘルスケアの歩数と活動データを任意で読み取り、歩数に応じたバトルやゲーム内報酬につなげます。
• 2つのデバイスで一緒に：iPhone とペアリングした Apple Watch で同じペットをお世話できます。
• ショップと記録：アイテムを選び、持ち物を管理し、成長や冒険の履歴を振り返れます。

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
This update improves care reminders and the Pro experience:

• Improved hunger and cleaning reminders, fixing issues that could cause missed or duplicate notifications.
• Fixed some bugs on Pro pages.
• Added links to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use on the crystal top-up page.

Improved the first pet egg welcome with clearer artwork and shorter guidance.

Added an exercise and coin rewards introduction when opening the journal for the first time, and improved the connection status after Health access is granted.

Moved action messages lower on the screen, refreshed their colors, and added a head shake when energy is too low.

Updated pet animation artwork.

Fixed a purchase confirmation that stayed visible after leaving the Shop and returning.

Step rewards now earn 1 coin per 1,000 steps. Claim your first 10 coins at 10,000 steps, then claim each additional coin as you walk. The daily limit remains 100 coins. Updated the Journal and Pet Care Guide to match.

• Fixed duplicate item drops, obscured guide content, and an issue preventing egg incubation after a pet’s death.
• Improved startup loading, shop previews, and purchase interactions.
• Improved step-based encounter notifications and added more care, mood, energy, sleep, wake-up, and level-up reminders.
• Claim step rewards as soon as you earn 3 coins. Adjusted hunger depletion rates.
• Personalize your pet’s home with new backgrounds. Purchase once and switch anytime from your bag.
• Added a feedback option in Settings.

• Fixed issues with feeding, medicine, and cleaning, and improved pet sleep behavior for smoother everyday care.
• Discover a new three-part video introduction to your pet adventure.
• Enjoy monthly Pro coin rewards: monthly and annual members receive 100 coins each month, while lifetime members receive 300 coins each month, credited automatically.
• See clearer membership benefits for your selected plan on the updated subscription screen.
• Tap a product’s name or effect description in the shop to open its purchase details.

- Fixed issues with Pro membership and monthly coin displays, Apple Watch item sync status, and repeated battle and item drop animations.
- Fixed unexpected Growth Chip drops. Training Tickets now fully restore energy and can be used when energy is low.
- Added Coin Dash, a mini-game where you jump to collect coins with your pet.
- Added daily coin check-ins to the Adventure Log, with an optional reminder at 9 AM local time.
-In Coin Dash, you can now jump from the area below the playfield. Tap for a short hop or press and hold to jump higher.
